How many trials about Alzheimer's disease were stopped early?
SELECT count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status IN ('TERMINATED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'SUSPENDED') AND lower(brief_title) LIKE '%alzheimer%'
What kinds of exclusions are most common in SAM.gov?
SELECT exclusion_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity was sold to retail customers in the United States in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS million_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.SALES.US-ALL.A' AND period = '2023'
In which months of 2022 did the most people die on the roads?
SELECT monthname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How was federal assistance split among grants, loans, insurance and direct payments in 2024?

SELECT assistance_type_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which recipients received the most in federal grants over the last 12 months?
SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(last_12_grants AS double) AS grants FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'R' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many campaign payments for polling were reported in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS payments FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2016' AND upper(purpose) LIKE '%POLL%'
Which technologies have the highest projected capital cost per kilowatt in 2035?

SELECT technology_alias, round(max(try_cast(value AS double)), 0) AS capex_per_kw FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe WHERE core_metric_parameter = 'CAPEX' AND scenario = 'Moderate' AND core_metric_variable = '2035' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much was spent on construction contracts at Army bases in Texas in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE ARMY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'TX' AND naics_code LIKE '23%' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2023'
Where has formal Clean Water Act enforcement been heaviest, state by state?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many different marketplace plans were sold in Texas in 2021?
SELECT count(DISTINCT planid) AS plans FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'TX' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021'
Which kinds of organisations file the most single audits?
SELECT entity_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE entity_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many synonyms does PubChem list for aspirin?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_synonym_filtered WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which counties have the most HUD-subsidized housing units?
SELECT name, states, max(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total reported value of Nvidia shares held by investment managers?
SELECT sum(try_cast(value AS double)) AS value FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer LIKE 'NVIDIA%'
Which hours of 2022 had the highest real-time power price in New York City?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone

SELECT time_stamp, try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much did Medicaid pay for Humira prescriptions in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND state = 'XX' AND product_name LIKE 'HUMIRA%'
Which companies drilled the most wells on the outer continental shelf?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns involved Toyota vehicles in 2010?
SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
Which granted patents contain the most extracted chemical reactions?
SELECT patentnumber, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE patentnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of mortgage applications were denied for each race of applicant in 2023?

SELECT derived_race, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which agencies' awards led to the most money passed on in sub-awards?
SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS subaward_dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people do active community water systems in New York serve?

SELECT sum(try_cast(population_served_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS' AND primacy_agency_code = 'NY'
Which journals have published the most high-energy physics papers?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE coalesce(journal_title, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs can be taken by mouth?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND oral = 1
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubMed papers are indexed under hemoglobins?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Hemoglobins'
What do companies pay doctors for, ranked by dollars, in 2022?

SELECT nature_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many formal water enforcement settlements were entered each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS settlements FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions WHERE substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What kinds of legal documents does the law collection hold most?
SELECT document_type, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do housing choice vouchers compare with public housing in total units nationwide?
SELECT program_label, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties outside Washington, D.C. send the most workers into the District?

SELECT substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) AS home_county, sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'dc' AND part = 'aux' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
